ChildrenArray.PresetDescription: This preset is designed for encoding YouTube festival set recordings (e.g., Tomorrowland, ASOT) into WebM format at 720p resolution for browser-based playback on the Xpeng G9 car screen. It uses the VP9 video encoder with a medium encoding speed and a Constant Quality value of 33, prioritizing small file sizes for long DJ sets. BT.709 colorspace is enforced for consistent color representation. Audio is passed through in Opus format to preserve mix quality. Multi-pass encoding is enabled for better bit allocation. CFR is used for maximum browser compatibility. Metadata is passed through to preserve tracklist chapter markers and CrateDigger tags.
